sections.text_helper: Section 19.4.3 "XSPI interface to memory modes" in chapter 19 (Extended-SPI interface (XSPI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 501.
sections.section_content:
The XSPI supports the following protocol:
• regular-command protocol
• HyperBus protocol
The XSPI uses from 6 to 12 signals to interface with a memory, depending on the functional
mode:
• NCS: chip-select (in the following sections, unless otherwise specified, NCS applies for
NCS1 or NCS2. Only one of these two signals is active at a given moment in time)
• CLK: communication clock
• DQS: data strobe used only in regular-command protocol as input only
• IO[3:0]: data bus LSB
• IO[7:4]:
– data bus MSB used in dual-quad and octal configurations
– data bus can be used as possible remap for quad-SPI mode
